item_short_desc: Rothco’s Mosquito Net Bar is designed to provide effective protection from mosquitos and other insects, making it ideal for outdoor use. Whether suspended inside a shelter, tent, or from a tree, this net ensures a restful night's sleep without the annoyance of bugs. Constructed from mildew-resistant netting with a fine marquisette weave, the net offers extra durability and enhanced insect protection. Reinforced edges and double-reinforced corners with ties add to the net's strength and durability.
description: Rothco’s Mosquito Net Bar is designed to provide effective protection from mosquitos and other insects, making it ideal for outdoor use. Whether suspended inside a shelter, tent, or from a tree, this net ensures a restful night's sleep without the annoyance of bugs. Constructed from mildew-resistant netting with a fine marquisette weave, the net offers extra durability and enhanced insect protection. Reinforced edges and double-reinforced corners with ties add to the net's strength and durability, making it reliable for extended use in various environments. Measuring 79 inches x 32 inches x 59inches, Rothco’s Mosquito Net Bar is perfectly sized to cover a cot or bed, ensuring complete coverage and protection. Lightweight and easy to pack, it’s the perfect companion for camping trips, hiking, or any outdoor adventure.
